current_assumptions_and_summary_findings.finding: All 24 other files in the active geometry source closure, including every theorem/proof input, match v24 byte-for-byte. The only changes are edition headers, the companion edition, and the exactly checked three-line arithmetic summary.

The full Introduction citation sequence and all 55 bibliography keys are retained. Every external bibliography entry is byte-identical. The only bibliography edit changes the companion draft from v24 to v25. No new external factual or priority claim was introduced by v25.

Definition def:fibration explicitly uses a compact branched finite 2-complex, permits specified core and branch singularities, and does not impose an ordinary smooth surface base or Whitney stratification. The abstract and Introduction preserve this distinction.

The global statements keep X_d smooth in P^3, d>=5, and [omega]=aH with a>0. The relative SNC theorem keeps no triple points, at least two marked intersection points per component, fixed positive weights [omega]=2pi sum w_a[D_a], freely selected normal holonomy, and a same-class representative omega-prime.

The active atlas definition uses ambient integer affine transition maps on the complement of focus values. The existence statement uses all-plane quintic/sextic constructions; the classification retains proportional-curvature SNC cores, the existing branch graph and coarse cones, and excludes additional branch singularities. It does not classify all Lagrangian torus fibrations.

Compared against fh25:matching and fh25:raw-equations. The summary stays within four-ray integer data with all pair products positive; the equivalence concerns existence of positive basin weights and the positive-sign graph being a perfect matching. It does not extend to zero pair products or unconstrained real entries.

Compared against ug25:local--ug25:budget-D and ug25:no-five. The summary applies to standard all-plane quintic integer gluing with two unit branches, nonnegative integer nodes of total 5, positive local weights and opposite D cancellation. Both unit branches have {4,1,0}; G514 itself and the other two support types are explicitly not excluded.

The updated paragraph explicitly calls the arithmetic statements necessary local-area/integer-gluing conditions and does not assert existence for the remaining three global supports. The established denominator-one atlas construction is unchanged.

The geometry paper continues to describe the arithmetic companion as an unpublished draft. Source review is a consistency check of current assumptions and changed claims, not external peer review or a reproof of all inherited theorems.

method: Read current root, complete Introduction and bibliography, main theorem statements and the actual SNC/atlas/classification hypotheses; compared exact active-source changes with v24; checked citation closure; read the new companion matching theorem and G514 theorem assumptions against the updated summary. No legacy proof scan was rerun.
